description: Tells the overseer where its factory ledger lives, re-injects the ledger after compaction or resume, and in the lite tier (LPF_TIER=lite) announces the tier and denies agent spawns that aren't on sonnet. The status mod (register.ts) shows factory status in a band above the prompt, Agent rows, the spinner, toasts and /factory, and reminds the overseer to update its ledger before auto-compaction.
